_description: ISCA'27 P21 main: m3p (M3+) + adaptive placement over the counter migration (4 KB tracking, 1 KB blocks): one benefit/cost decision per page over the action set move, block, spread (hot: ring 12 if the buffer is concentrated, else stay), replicate (hot read-only concentrated pages, 4 copies on tiles 8/12/36/40, collapsed by any write or kernel boundary), predict (per-buffer rule pre-places untouched pages). Global parameters from results_index/adapt/offline.md: alpha 2, fixed 2 us, hot = 4 GPMs first-read within 2 us, conc 0.3, predict m 2. pm defaults otherwise (sw 5 us, shootdown 1 us, batch 256), max 2 migrations per page. Round 2 (flag defaults): copy-first migration (copy while the old frame stays mapped, hold only for shootdown + drain + recopy of written blocks), touched neighbours do not follow a predicted batch, early rule observations (first 8 counted accesses with a dominant GPM), an access to a page being pre-placed waits for its copy (moved to the front of the queue); copy engine pull window counted in bytes (16 x 4 KB). Ablations override -pm-adapt-actions / -pm-adapt-costmodel on the command line. See isca27/prompts/P21_adaptive_migration.md.
